entries.rationale: finalize.py HAND_BLOCK_FIRST: the preserved detection is the FAILED auto detection (occlusion/median coincidence) that Builder B replaced by a visual-verification manual pick; V-Env frame read on ep411 supports the pick (JSON ~2-3cm from visible cube, detection ~13cm off on empty mat). Detection px retained as the failed-auto record.

JSON final = stack location (mean of top_final cube detections; re-derived mean deviates 0.0 cm from JSON, rounding/median-pass differences only). The per-colour final detection px measures an individual colour blob in top_final (often only the visible top cube or lettering), NOT the stack location - a different quantity, not a competing pose. Builder C build_scenes derives its own stack px (detection nearest base initial) from the same preserved pixels.
JSON pose re-derives from preserved detection px through calib_v2 homography.
